summary: A continuous scalar factor times a correlation of compactly supported continuous functions.

steps.lean: choose L _ a _ using hF.exists_gauge_isHead _ p p 0
steps.claim: A gauge of size L making p a head of length ϱ (exists_gauge_isHead), with its data a.
Assemble the continuity from the pieces below.

have : Continuous fun c : (_ → ℂˣ) × 𝔰.G₁ ↦ cellChart 𝔰 𝔰.ϱ (c.1 𝔰.ϱ) :=

      (M := ℝ) ?_ (((PiLp.continuous_toLp ..).comp_continuousOn (continuousOn_pi.2 fun i ↦

    · ▸ by simp))).continuousAt ((Set.finite_Iic _).eventually_all.2 fun i l ↦ (ContinuousAt.norm

steps.claim: c ↦ cellChart(𝔰, ϱ, c_ϱ) is continuous in its matrix entries; the scalar factor of normCorrelation is continuous; and each coordinate ∫ F_i(y)·conj(F_j(γ_c⁻¹y)) dy is continuous in c by continuity of parametric integrals with compact support: the integrand vanishes unless y has Γ-size L + 1 (hasMatSize_of_ne_zero), a compact set (isCompact_hasMatSize).
